question: Does exact tied-rank enumeration explain reported versus reproduced direct-test discrepancies without changing observations?
decision: Resolve calculation conventions where possible and preserve any remaining source discrepancy.
strongest_rival: Attrition, mislabeled panels/scales, mixed doses, shared normalization and absent stable mouse IDs can overstate treatment evidence.
discriminator: Separate direct group tests from chance tests; preserve all 16 declared endpoint blocks, dose-specific nesting, original denominators and arithmetic discrepancies.
exposure_record: All original data and v1 numerical results exposed before v2. GraphPad official tie documentation read after discrepancies were seen. Diagnostic amendment, not confirmation.
biological_unit: Individual mouse within each panel as documented by legends; source coordinates are not cross-assay mouse identities.
nesting_and_overlap: Sections averaged within mice. Two neurogenesis/FACS blocks retained. Combined nesting reuses high/low cohorts with WT only high. Cognition panels share original cohort but have different attrition; no per-mouse task join.
population_and_selection: All available numerical observations in 16 predeclared S4 panels/ranges under original seven-stage priorities; aged males with contextual young controls.
contrast: D25K-Control, WT-Control, D25K-WT where arms exist; reported Young-Control and RIPR-Control. Dose/cohort descriptions separated from mixed-dose aggregate reproduction.
endpoint: Reconciled direct-test probabilities and exact method differences; no new effect estimates.
methods: Exact integer dynamic programming for all reported direct contrasts. Preserve pooled average tied ranks and sample sizes. Two-sided doubled smaller inclusive tail and absolute-distance tail are both output. Independent brute enumeration and SciPy permutation validation when allocations <=50000.
missingness_and_exclusions: Blank source cells are missing. Exclude only declared summary rows. Preserve published attrition without invented mouse IDs. No dropping data to match a P value or cached mean; ambiguities remain findings.
multiplicity: Unadjusted published tests reproduced; no new familywise discovery/equivalence decision. Predeclared unreported comparisons are diagnostic only.
precision_basis: No justified effect margin or numerical precision basis recovered. No post-hoc power; ambiguous scales and shared normalizers limit further uncertainty claims.
interpretation_limit: Same-source reproduction, not independent replication. No WT cognition, mediation, age interaction, injury repair or unsupported physical-unit conversion. No cross-panel row matching.
stop_rule: Fail if label-allocation totals or independent calculations disagree. Retain residual discrepancies; never alter source values, rounding or selected rows.
amendment_reason: V1 tie approximation differed from reported P values. Official GraphPad documentation describes exact tied-rank calculations; assess all reported contrasts, not only favorable ones.
